name: Publisher Identity Verification
description: Verify the identity of the publisher before signing. OIDC-based identity binding.
purpose: Bind every signed artifact to a verified publisher identity through OIDC so consumers can trust that the artifact was produced by the claimed entity and not an impersonator.
acceptanceCriteria: Publisher identity is verified via OIDC (OpenID Connect) before any signing operation.
OIDC token is obtained from the CI provider (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.) and validated.
Identity binding maps the OIDC issuer + subject to a known publisher identity in the project.
Signing operation fails if the OIDC identity does not match the expected publisher.
Verified identity is embedded in the signing certificate (Fulcio).
Identity verification is logged for audit purposes.
Identity verification is tested with a negative test (non-matching identity is rejected).
